# Source C search log (Semantic Scholar + web search + list/crawl snowball)

Run 2026-09-13 by a search agent, per docs/efficiency-audit-protocol.md section 1 (Source C). Candidate list only; no screening against inclusion criteria was done. Output: `sourceC_candidates.jsonl` (159 candidates).

## Method notes

- Web search: Claude Code WebSearch tool (US results). Each query below lists the number of result links returned and the arXiv ids it contributed to the candidate file (ids in parentheses were seen but not kept as candidates).
- Semantic Scholar Graph API: `/paper/arXiv:<id>/citations`, `/references` (limit 1000, paginated) and `/recommendations/v1/papers/forpaper/arXiv:<id>` (limit 100) for 32 seed papers; `/paper/search` (limit 100) for 40 keyword queries. The search endpoint returned HTTP 429 for most of the session (shared unauthenticated rate limit); queries that never succeeded are marked below.
- S2 results were pooled, restricted to arXiv ids 2401-2609, and keyword-filtered (VLA/robot term AND efficiency term in title+abstract), then titles were hand-reviewed; kept ids are listed per crawl.
- GitHub list `guanweifan/awesome-efficient-vla` (live hub for survey arXiv:2510.17111, updated to 2026-08-17; 207 entries) was parsed and hand-filtered.
- Verification only (not discovery): arXiv abs pages fetched for all kept ids (title, abstract, v1 date). For ids whose abstract does not mention LIBERO, the arXiv HTML full text was fetched and LIBERO mentions counted (>=6 -> libero_likely=yes, 1-5 -> unknown, 0 -> no; HTML unavailable -> manual judgement kept). The arXiv export API and arxiv.org/search returned 429 at session start and were not used.
- libero_likely is a pre-screen guess only. method_family is a guess; 'borderline' marks items whose primary contribution may not be accelerating an existing VLA (new architectures with efficiency claims, async/execution-speed methods, world action models, non-VLA diffusion policies, systems/runtime papers, analyses).

## Coverage limitations

- Semantic Scholar keyword search was heavily rate-limited (HTTP 429); see the table above for which queries completed. S2 citation graphs for 2026 papers are sparse (e.g. SnapFlow 7 citations, 0 references indexed; AdaVLA/SpecVLA/Gated VLA-Cache 0 citations), so snowballing under-covers mid-2026 onward.
- Google Scholar was not queried (no API; blocked for automated access). arXiv listing/search was rate-limited and not used for discovery (Source A covers the arXiv API).
- libero_likely for ids without HTML full text relies on abstract/web snippets. v1 dates are from arXiv abs-page submission history.
